memory_update.text: SENEA is a priority underfollowed candidate for the private-label/value-tier staples contract-manufacturing node because FY2025 disclosures show economically material food-packaging exposure and direct private-label/contract-packing relationships.

JBSS is a priority underfollowed candidate because private-brand bidding, snack/nut/bar manufacturing, and two-customer concentration around roughly half of FY2025 sales create a clear hidden customer-dependency research path.
REYN should be retained as a reference-adjacent household consumables supplier, not the main alpha-hunt target, because it is larger and more visible but has explicit store-brand exposure.

BRID is a speculative shadow candidate only; private-label relevance is explicit, but sub-$300m market cap, likely low liquidity, customer concentration, and possible financial fragility require aggressive falsification before promotion.

TreeHouse Foods would have been an obvious pure-play private-label reference historically, but current search context indicates it was taken private; do not treat THS as a current US-listed candidate without re-verifying listing status.

For later layers, separate true private-label manufacturers from branded food companies with incidental co-pack exposure; the key falsification variables are private-label revenue share, customer concentration, qualification gates, plant utilization, recall history, and gross-margin durability under retailer bidding pressure.
